title: 環境土木工学設計Ⅱ
subtitle: Design in Civil and Environmental Engineering II
keywords: Civil engineering discipline 2.Engineering rationality via scientific principles 3.Essential knowledge and skills of civil engineers 4.Reflection on actions of practical engineers
educationalGoal: Students will: (1) become acquainted with civil engineering discipline. (2) learn engineering rationality via scientific principles. (3) learn essential knowledge and skills necessary for civil engineers. (4) learn to reflect on the actions of practitioners.
advice: Students learn the ethics of civil engineering in this course. We will cover the following topics: 1. Civil engineering discipline: morals, ethics, discipline, self-governance and governance by others 2. Engineering rationality via scientific principles: knowledge creation by scientific exploration, significance of scientific knowledge, intellectual responsibility stemming from scientific rationality. 3. Essential knowledge and skills of civil engineers: social roles of civil engineers, integrated rubric of outcomes by ASCE2008, professional competences by IEA. 4. Reflection on actions of practical engineers: Reflective actions of practical engineers, technical experts and reflective practitioners, relevance and social legitimacy. Precautions Students are required to actively participate in class.
requiredKnowledge: Topics learned in Design in Civil and Environmental Engineering I.
